Think again: go back to the output encoding and the update condition.

b705f98971c9.zh: 人工智慧基礎 · AI FOUNDATIONS

a62f469f8f15.zh:
Perceptron
Signum · 更新 · 幾何
Signum · Updates · Geometry

dce7c872dd23.zh: 把「老骨董」拆成三個可計算的支柱 Three computable pillars inside the classic model.
dce7c872dd23.en: Taking the “antique” apart into three computable pillars

997b39163f43.zh: 加權輸入 Weighted Input ±1 啟用 Signum 超平面 Geometry
997b39163f43.en: Weighted input ±1 activation: Signum Hyperplane geometry

913ff3ce6ad4.zh: 向下滾動：先看輸出編碼，再看錯誤如何驅動更新 Scroll down: encode, update, then visualize.
913ff3ce6ad4.en: Scroll down: first see how the output is encoded, then how errors drive the updates

a2df9af97b92.zh:
換成 $+1$ 與 $-1$，
為什麼錯誤會變漂亮？Why does the error become cleaner with $+1$ and $-1$?
a2df9af97b92.en:
Switch to $+1$ and $-1$:
why does the error suddenly look so neat?

b2acee4a4582.zh: 我們不是為了把符號換得更酷，而是讓「猜錯多少」直接暴露成 $\pm 2$。 The recoding makes a wrong prediction reveal a fixed magnitude: $\pm 2$.
b2acee4a4582.en: We aren’t swapping the symbols just to look cooler; we do it so that “how wrong the guess was” shows up directly as $\pm 2$.

91d80efc276f.zh: 先辨識三大支柱，再把 Signum 的誤差推成更新公式，最後把公式放回特徵平面。 Pillars → Signum error → update rule → feature geometry.
91d80efc276f.en: First identify the three pillars, then turn the Signum error into the update rule, and finally put the rule back onto the feature plane.

4678cda5b6c8.zh: Perceptron 的三大支柱 Three Pillars of the Perceptron
4678cda5b6c8.en: The Three Pillars of the Perceptron

f609ae50fa22.zh: 現代模型再複雜，也仍能在這裡看到「輸入如何被加總、輸出如何做決策、錯誤如何改設定值」的骨架。 Complex models still echo weighted inputs, decisions, and parameter updates.
f609ae50fa22.en: However complex modern models get, you can still see this skeleton in them: “how the inputs are summed, how the output makes a decision, and how errors change the parameters.”

25cbcfb68e1d.zh: 每個特徵乘上權重，表示它在目前決策中的影響力。 Weights encode feature influence.
25cbcfb68e1d.en: Each feature is multiplied by a weight, which expresses how much influence it has on the current decision.

93194aad94c5.zh: 把連續的總分轉成類別符號，決定輸出哪一側。 An activation turns a score into a class sign.
93194aad94c5.en: Turns the continuous total score into a class sign, deciding which side the output falls on.

beeeeed34cd3.zh: 預測錯誤時，沿著標籤指向修正設定值；猜對則保持不動。 Mistakes move parameters; correct cases stay still.
beeeeed34cd3.en: When the prediction is wrong, correct the parameters in the direction the label points; when the guess is right, leave them where they are.

b2cccb844735.zh: 牛肉入不入味與冷氣涼不涼可以有不同權重；模型不是「有感覺」，只是把重要性寫進乘法。 Different features get different numerical influence.
b2cccb844735.en: Whether the beef is well-marinated and whether the air conditioning is cold enough can carry different weights; the model doesn’t “have feelings,” it just writes importance into a multiplication.

b4d836bd16a4.zh: 從格子派到正負號派 Binary Step vs. Signum
b4d836bd16a4.en: From Team Bins to Team Signs

531254007cf1.zh: 二元步階使用 $\{0,1\}$；Signum 改用 $\{+1,-1\}$，讓「方向」直接留在標籤裡。 Binary Step uses $\{0,1\}$; Signum keeps class direction as $\{+1,-1\}$.
531254007cf1.en: The binary step uses $\{0,1\}$; Signum switches to $\{+1,-1\}$, so the “direction” stays right inside the label.

2017217f3942.zh: 輸出像分班格子：不是 1，就是 0。 A crisp two-bin decision.
2017217f3942.en: The output is like sorting students into two classrooms: if it isn’t 1, it’s 0.

55e0c4cab9b4.zh: 適合二元開關 A binary switch.
55e0c4cab9b4.en: Good for a binary on/off switch

7e891d3cedd6.zh: 誤差差值不會固定成同一個量級 The error gap is less symmetric.
7e891d3cedd6.en: The error difference doesn’t settle at one fixed magnitude

5e405358ccc3.zh: 等於零的邊界案例先略過，重點放在兩側方向。 Ignore the zero edge case and focus on direction.
5e405358ccc3.en: Set aside the edge case of exactly zero for now; the focus is the direction on each side.

04522adbab65.zh: 正類是 $+1$，負類是 $-1$ Positive is $+1$; negative is $-1$.
04522adbab65.en: The positive class is $+1$, the negative class is $-1$

0e6439cda699.zh: 猜錯時差值必為 $\pm 2$ A mistake always creates $\pm 2$.
0e6439cda699.en: When the guess is wrong, the difference is always $\pm 2$

9658d1381ff3.zh: 編碼的效果 · Why the recoding helps

474cc7677658.zh: 這不是改變資料的真實意義，而是換一種對更新規則更友善的表示法。 The labels change representation, not meaning.
474cc7677658.en: This doesn’t change what the data really means; it is just a different representation that is friendlier to the update rule.

5cda7a617f0e.zh: 四種組合，其實只剩兩種結果 Four Combinations, Two Outcomes
5cda7a617f0e.en: Four Combinations, Really Only Two Outcomes

80f3319bfaef.zh: 在 $\{+1,-1\}$ 的世界裡，先把 $y_i-o_i$ 寫出來，更新規則就不再像黑箱。 Expand $y_i-o_i$ and the update rule becomes transparent.
80f3319bfaef.en: In the world of $\{+1,-1\}$, once you write out $y_i-o_i$, the update rule stops looking like a black box.

6619b742c898.zh: 誤差的壓縮結論 · Compressed Error

8e173a83c3a3.zh: 猜對是 0；猜錯只有 $\pm 2$，因此修正方向由 $y_i$ 決定。 Correct means zero; wrong means a signed step of magnitude two.
8e173a83c3a3.en: A correct guess gives 0; a wrong guess can only give $\pm 2$, so the direction of the correction is decided by $y_i$.

c1d59ee04687.zh: 把差值推成更新 From Error Difference to Update
c1d59ee04687.en: Turning the Difference into an Update

4ec3d29a70fe.zh: 這條式子把誤差乘上特徵，形成設定值修正量。 Error times input becomes the parameter correction.
4ec3d29a70fe.en: This formula multiplies the error by the feature to form the parameter correction.

2720059d9638.zh: 只看猜錯案例 · Misclassified case

70b200156a2e.zh: 因此可改寫為： For a mistake, the rule simplifies to:
70b200156a2e.en: So it can be rewritten as:

9f2f8c3d9e76.zh: 偏置也一起更新 · Bias update

189426ea43eb.zh: 若把偏置視為常數特徵 $1$，它同樣沿著錯誤方向修正。 Treating bias as a constant feature gives the same logic.
189426ea43eb.en: If we treat the bias as a constant feature $1$, it is corrected along the error direction in the same way.

f4dff9e806fa.zh: 名詞辨識 · Name the loss correctly

773ca2c98127.zh: 這裡的 $y_i-o_i$ 是感知機的預測誤差，不是 Lasso 的罰金；Lasso 是另一種正則化方法。 This is perceptron error, not a Lasso penalty.
773ca2c98127.en: Here $y_i-o_i$ is the perceptron’s prediction error, not a Lasso penalty; Lasso is a different regularization method.

73897667da3d.zh: $\mathcal{M}$ 表示目前被分錯的樣本集合；只累加需要修正的資料。 Sum only over the misclassified set $\mathcal{M}$.
73897667da3d.en: $\mathcal{M}$ denotes the set of currently misclassified samples; we sum only over the data that needs correcting.

81ca27d055af.zh: 手算一：猜錯了 Worked Example 1 — Wrong Prediction

25030096bf28.zh: 把「讀書時數」當成唯一特徵：$x_i=10$，真實標籤是 $y_i=-1$（不及格）。 One feature: ten study hours, but the true class is $-1$.
25030096bf28.en: Take “hours of study” as the only feature: $x_i=10$, and the true label is $y_i=-1$ (fail).

5d97dc63c801.zh: $z=5\gt 0$，所以輸出 $+1$。 A positive score predicts $+1$.

ef0bc99f4ee4.zh: $y_i-o_i=-2$，修正方向朝負類。 The error points toward class $-1$.
ef0bc99f4ee4.en: $y_i-o_i=-2$, so the correction points toward the negative class.

93df0ae54c4b.zh: 讀懂結果 · Read the result

d41a31d0d8ae.zh: 模型不是被「狠狠修理」，而是依照可追蹤的乘法把錯誤放大到輸入尺度，再改變下一次決策。 The correction is traceable: error scaled by the input changes the next decision.
d41a31d0d8ae.en: The model isn’t getting “punished hard”; through a traceable multiplication, the error is scaled up to the size of the input, which then changes the next decision.

263aa0e83716.zh: 手算二：猜對了 Worked Example 2 — Correct Prediction

59095dc69ad9.zh: 換一筆資料：$x_i=1$、$y_i=-1$，並沿用剛剛更新後的 $w=-1.5$ 與 $w_0=-0.2$。 Reuse the updated parameters on a new negative example.
59095dc69ad9.en: Take a new data point: $x_i=1$, $y_i=-1$, and keep the just-updated $w=-1.5$ and $w_0=-0.2$.

4665d40cfb29.zh: 總分與輸出 · Score and output

38931fd82347.zh: 真實標籤也是 $-1$，因此 $o_i=y_i$。 The prediction matches the true label.
38931fd82347.en: The true label is also $-1$, so $o_i=y_i$.

b596bfff67d8.zh: 不需要更新 · No update needed

94d36385d16b.zh: 所以 $w$ 與 $w_0$ 保持原值；猜對就原地不動。 Correct predictions leave the parameters unchanged.
94d36385d16b.en: So $w$ and $w_0$ keep their values; a correct guess stays put.

6d7c91a2357e.zh: 對照前一例 · Compare with Example 1

95f54602341c.zh: 猜錯帶來有方向的修正；猜對把修正量消成 0。 Mistakes move; correct cases stay still.
95f54602341c.en: A wrong guess brings a correction with a direction; a correct guess cancels the correction down to 0.

61abff13147f.zh: Perceptron 的學習不是每筆資料都改，而是僅在預測與標籤不一致時改。 Learning happens only when prediction and label disagree.
61abff13147f.en: The perceptron doesn’t learn by changing on every data point; it changes only when the prediction and the label disagree.

1441b47b9d57.zh: Perceptron 是幾何雕刻家嗎？ Decision Boundary and Normal Vector
1441b47b9d57.en: Is the Perceptron a Geometry Sculptor?

0ff875640c03.zh: 它確實在特徵平面上畫出邊界，但單一 Perceptron 畫的是直線；真正的超能力是用權重決定方向。 A single perceptron draws a linear boundary; weights set its orientation.
0ff875640c03.en: It does draw a boundary on the feature plane, but a single perceptron draws a straight line; its real superpower is using the weights to set the direction.

1f27c4399b2d.zh: 虛線是決策邊界；品紅箭頭是法向量，永遠垂直於邊界 · Boundary and normal.
1f27c4399b2d.en: The dashed line is the decision boundary; the magenta arrow is the normal vector, always perpendicular to the boundary.

20184efc582b.zh: 當 $s(\mathbf{x})=0$ 時得到決策邊界；正負號分別位於邊界兩側。 The sign of the score selects a side of the boundary.
20184efc582b.en: Setting $s(\mathbf{x})=0$ gives the decision boundary; the positive and negative signs lie on the two sides of the boundary.

275c0781f486.zh: 法向量的工作 · What the normal does

38178137f285.zh: $\mathbf{w}=[w_1,w_2]$ 決定邊界的垂直方向；改變權重就會旋轉這條線。 Weights orient the perpendicular direction.
38178137f285.en: $\mathbf{w}=[w_1,w_2]$ sets the direction perpendicular to the boundary; changing the weights rotates this line.

a6656968add8.zh: 單一 Perceptron 本身只能做線性切割；「非線性切割」需要特徵轉換或多層網路，不是這一條直線自己完成。 Nonlinear separation needs transformed features or multiple layers.
a6656968add8.en: A single perceptron by itself can only make linear cuts; a “nonlinear cut” needs feature transformations or a multilayer network, and is not something this one straight line does on its own.

933aea56f60b.zh: 投影分數：把二維資料壓成一條軸 Projection Score: 2D to 1D
933aea56f60b.en: Projection Score: Squeezing 2D Data onto One Axis

b2c602909b7d.zh: 選擇 $\mathbf{w}=[1,1]$ 時，先看原始投影 $p(\mathbf{x})=\mathbf{w}^{\top}\mathbf{x}$；再加上偏置得到決策分數 $s(\mathbf{x})=p(\mathbf{x})+b$。 Project first, then shift the score with the bias.
b2c602909b7d.en: With $\mathbf{w}=[1,1]$, first look at the raw projection $p(\mathbf{x})=\mathbf{w}^{\top}\mathbf{x}$; then add the bias to get the decision score $s(\mathbf{x})=p(\mathbf{x})+b$.

16b1c6c9c23b.zh: 十個樣本的實算 · Ten Samples, Real Computation

dd8a46a369df.zh: 資料點 A 的原始投影為 5，資料點 B 的原始投影為 16；滑動偏置，觀察整條分數軸如何平移。 Class A projects to 5; class B projects to 16. Bias shifts every score.
dd8a46a369df.en: The A points have a raw projection of 5 and the B points a raw projection of 16; slide the bias and watch the whole score axis shift.

e9b7065ed561.zh: 類間與類內 · Between and within classes

fc64d9f6c08d.zh: 本例讓同類樣本的原始投影集中在 5 或 16，清楚展示「投影後的分數軸」；這是觀察工具，不代表 Perceptron 自動完成降維學習。 The projection is an analysis lens, not automatic dimensionality reduction.
fc64d9f6c08d.en: In this example the raw projections of same-class samples are concentrated at 5 or 16, which clearly shows the “projected score axis”; this is an observation tool and does not mean the perceptron automatically learns a dimensionality reduction.

4fc741b8c224.zh: 由分數回到分類 · From score to class

2a2457a04272.zh: 以 0 為決策基準時，$s(\mathbf{x})\gt 0$ 輸出 $+1$，$s(\mathbf{x})\lt 0$ 輸出 $-1$。 The sign of the shifted score gives the class.
2a2457a04272.en: With 0 as the decision threshold, $s(\mathbf{x})\gt 0$ outputs $+1$ and $s(\mathbf{x})\lt 0$ outputs $-1$.

eaad3484f49b.zh: 三題提取練習 Three Retrieval Questions

1ee43b872f42.zh: 不要只認公式；請把每個符號放回「輸出、錯誤、幾何」的因果鏈。 Place every symbol back into the causal chain.
1ee43b872f42.en: Don’t just recognize formulas; put each symbol back into the causal chain of “output, error, geometry.”

ad3fd9e4d43e.zh: Q1 · Signum 猜錯時，$y_i-o_i$ 是什麼？What is the error magnitude for a Signum mistake?
ad3fd9e4d43e.en: Q1 · When Signum guesses wrong, what is $y_i-o_i$?

33e7cb29809e.zh: Q2 · 法向量 $\mathbf{w}$ 代表什麼？What does $\mathbf{w}$ represent?
33e7cb29809e.en: Q2 · What does the normal vector $\mathbf{w}$ represent?

20156c2a4c31.zh: 邊界的垂直方向 The perpendicular direction
20156c2a4c31.en: The direction perpendicular to the boundary

9ca3dd5ef622.zh: 資料筆數 The sample count

3e133a1e9fc5.zh: 固定學習率 The learning rate

23d9084ba9fd.zh: Q3 · 什麼情況下設定值不動？When do parameters stay unchanged?
23d9084ba9fd.en: Q3 · When do the parameters stay unchanged?

7bbb4b0577d6.zh: 預測正確 When prediction is correct

41108c2c8312.zh: 先判斷標籤編碼，再判斷是否猜錯，最後才代入更新式。 Encode → compare → update.
41108c2c8312.en: First determine the label encoding, then whether the guess is wrong, and only then plug into the update rule.

7aafeaf21b5e.zh: 把 Perceptron 帶走 Take the Perceptron With You

bcaea2941490.zh: 正類 $+1$、負類 $-1$，錯誤因此呈現 $\pm2$。 Labels carry direction; mistakes become $\pm2$.
bcaea2941490.en: Positive class $+1$, negative class $-1$, so errors show up as $\pm2$.

3228ab95f21b.zh: 猜錯才更新；猜對時 $y_i-o_i=0$。 Mistakes move parameters; correct cases do not.
3228ab95f21b.en: Update only when wrong; when right, $y_i-o_i=0$.

542e7d15015f.en: The weights are the normal vector

49e9236d16db.zh: $\mathbf{w}$ 垂直於 $s(\mathbf{x})=0$ 的決策邊界。 Weights define the boundary’s normal.
49e9236d16db.en: $\mathbf{w}$ is perpendicular to the decision boundary $s(\mathbf{x})=0$.

7ccf959291f4.en: Next: on to multiple layers and nonlinearity

2bc26f667962.zh: 若一條直線不夠，就需要特徵轉換或 MLP。 Next: feature transforms or multilayer networks.
2bc26f667962.en: If one straight line isn’t enough, you need feature transformations or an MLP.

7c86aa45746f.zh: Signum 把錯誤變成方向；更新把方向寫回權重；幾何把權重畫成法向量。 Signum exposes direction, updates write it into weights, geometry makes it visible.
7c86aa45746f.en: Signum turns errors into directions; the update writes the direction back into the weights; geometry draws the weights as a normal vector.

bb7f0b50b247.zh: 帶著這三個問題進入下一節：邊界能否分開資料？錯誤會不會收斂？多層網路如何突破單一直線？ Ask: separability, convergence, and how multilayer nets escape one line.
bb7f0b50b247.en: Take these three questions into the next section: Can the boundary separate the data? Will the errors converge? How does a multilayer network break past a single straight line?

1537744a8278.en: Projection score chart for ten samples
